references.text: The people gathered as one man, the same expression used here to describe their unity in decision
The Israelites had taken a solemn oath to act together, showing the same unity as in this verse
Saul gathered the people as one man to go to war, the same expression for national unity
The people rose up as one man to build the temple, showing the same collective determination
The people gathered as one man to hear the law, the same expression for unity
The people decided to return, a collective decision like this one
Reference to returning to their tents, the same language about going home
